note: Worked format example using published measurements. The four rows are excluded from ML credit because the cited analyses do not demonstrate ML performance for these outputs. Only team-checked studies that evaluate ML can support a pass.

tasks.observable_or_target: presence of a transient gravitational-wave signal rather than detector noise

papers.title: Observation of Gravitational Waves from a Binary Black Hole Merger
papers.match_rationale: The matched-filter search detects GW150914. Its reported false-alarm rate assesses detection significance; this analysis supplies no trained-model performance.
papers.retrieval_method: Organizer-selected published measurement for the format example.
papers.metric: matched-filter SNR and false-alarm rate (search statistics)
papers.reported_result: SNR 24, false alarm rate < 1 per 203 000 years
papers.input_modality: calibrated strain time series from LIGO Hanford and Livingston
papers.setting: LIGO Hanford and Livingston, transient searches, binary black hole coalescence

papers.title: Observing gravitational-wave transient GW150914 with minimal assumptions
papers.input_modality: time-frequency power map constructed from whitened strain in both LIGO detectors
papers.match_rationale: The cWB search detects a transient using coherent excess power. This is the same detection objective as the matched-filter search, with a different representation. The cited cWB analysis evaluates a search statistic.
papers.evidence_text: These searches identify time-correlated transients in multiple detectors
papers.evidence_location: abstract; cWB input described in the section titled “cWB pipeline overview”
papers.retrieval_method: Organizer-selected published measurement for the format example.

tasks.task_label: Estimate the remnant black hole mass
tasks.observable_or_target: source-frame mass of the remnant black hole (solar masses)

papers.title: Observation of Gravitational Waves from a Binary Black Hole Merger
papers.input_modality: calibrated strain time series from LIGO Hanford and Livingston
papers.retrieval_method: Organizer-selected published measurement for the format example.
papers.setting: GW150914, inference from binary black hole waveform models
papers.match_rationale: This analysis infers a remnant mass of 62 solar masses, with a 90% credible interval of 58–66 solar masses. Mass is the inferred output. The credible interval describes uncertainty on that event; it is not a trained model’s prediction error.
papers.evidence_text: the final black hole mass is 62+4−4M⊙

tasks.task_label: Dijet transverse-momentum imbalance as a function of PbPb collision centrality
tasks.observable_or_target: distribution of the dijet transverse-momentum asymmetry in bins of collision centrality

papers.match_rationale: CMS measures the imbalance of the two jets across centrality bins. The passage establishes a measurement; it does not evaluate a trained regressor.
papers.evidence_text: a striking imbalance in dijet transverse momentum is observed
papers.retrieval_method: Organizer-selected published measurement for the format example.
papers.input_modality: leading and subleading reconstructed calorimeter-jet transverse momenta, with a collision centrality estimate
papers.setting: CMS PbPb collisions at 2.76 TeV per nucleon pair, leading jet transverse momentum above 120 GeV/c
